g.text: EventFlow â€” Sequence Diagram: Register for Event
Scope: implemented attendee-facing "Register for Event" flow.
UI preconditions: authenticated attendee role, event not ended,
getRegistrations() loads existing registration state for every event.
1 â€” Page load and private invitation validation
Page errors: "This event is private and requires a valid invitation link to access.",
"Invalid invitation link", "This invitation link has already been used",
or "Wrong account" when invitedEmail differs from the logged-in email.
SELECT event fields + profile/user email; apply event guards
Event guards: "Event not found", "This event is not open for registration",
"The registration deadline has passed", "This event has already ended",
Validate invitation code in service order
Service order: missing code â†’ "An invitation code is required for this private event";
unknown â†’ "Invalid invitation link"; used â†’ "This invitation link has already been used";
wrong event â†’ "This invitation link does not belong to this event";
email mismatch â†’ "This invitation was sent to a different email address".
Organizer lookup is two SELECTs (events â†’ profiles);
Registration and waitlist placement use in-app notifications only â€” no email.
A later waitlist promotion after another attendee's cancellation creates a ticket,
and an email attempt that is mock by default.
